Coverage_Description: GP outpatient (face-to-face/online, up to 3-day basic medication), traditional Chinese medical outpatient consultation (referral required), annual dental scaling, proactive health; shared annual consultation cap by plan: 12 / 20 / 25-30 visits
pricing: Annual premium: HKD 1,888 (Plan 1), HKD 2,688 (Plan 2), HKD 3,858 (Plan 3), covering insured + up to 2 designated family members; copayment per consultation: HKD 20 (Hong Kong) / MOP 20 (Macau) / CNY 8 (Mainland China).
customer requirement: Policy owner is the insured; up to 2 designated immediate family members (spouse/child/parent)
price structure: Tiered annual premium by plan level (Plan 1/2/3), one policy covers insured + up to 2 family members; per-visit copayment
additional informations: Coverage period up to age 81; yearly renewable without new insurability evidence (subject to premium/benefit revision or non-renewal notice); compassionate death benefit HKD 5,000 (insured only)
